name: @t3flare/demo-video
description: t3flare's launch video, made with Remotion from real T3 Code desktop footage

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && remotion compositions
scripts.brand: remotion still LogoOnDark ../../docs/assets/t3flare-logo-dark.png --image-format=png && remotion still LogoOnLight ../../docs/assets/t3flare-logo-light.png --image-format=png && remotion still AppIcon ../../docs/assets/t3flare-app-icon.png --image-format=png
